name: photo-meta-lens
description: 图片EXIF元数据沉浸式可视化
tagline: See the unseen story behind every shot.
interaction: Hover over any region of a photo to reveal a radial lens that surfaces EXIF metadata — camera model, aperture, shutter speed, GPS coordinates — as floating, context-aware cards that drift and fade with your cursor movement. The metadata lens distorts the image beneath it with a subtle glass-refraction effect, making invisible data feel tactile and spatial. Pinch or scroll to zoom the lens depth, toggling between surface-level stats and deep technical histograms.
